A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Before you call.

Do you offer 24-hour plumbing service?+

Yes. Call (951) 238-5089 to discuss your situation and availability. This website does not guarantee an arrival time.

What should I do in a plumbing emergency?+

Call directly for active flooding, uncontrolled leaks, or wastewater backups. Stop using affected fixtures. Only shut off water if you know how and can safely reach the valve.

How can I tell if I have a hidden leak?+

Unexpected consumption, damp surfaces, staining, and water sounds when fixtures are off can be clues. These symptoms need investigation; they do not establish a diagnosis.

Do you offer community discounts?+

Ask about senior, essential worker, and military discounts. Contact DLR for availability and eligibility.

Which communities do you serve?+

DLR is based in Menifee and serves Southern California. Call with your city and property location to confirm coverage before scheduling.

How do I choose between repair and replacement?+

Condition, parts availability, recurring problems, and the scope of repair all matter. Ask for findings and options before making a decision.
